⭐ **The deliverable is the SUPPLY SIDE — two documents that teach the phantom title**, which is very likely where that hand-typed query came from:

```
.changeset/README.md   2. **Bot creates "Version Packages" PR** → Updates versions and changelogs
CONTRIBUTING.md        2. **PR is merged** → Changeset bot creates/updates a "Version Packages" PR
```

This repo's bot has **never** produced that title — it produces `chore: release packages`. ⇒ a seat following `CONTRIBUTING.md` learns a string that can never match.

## LANDED — `2ae014f969cdc455f476980671cf35f27fb9ab99`. Probe on `<merge>^ <merge>`: **5 of 5 legs pass.**

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), R55. PR objectui#9314 merged 2026-09-12T19:4xZ.

⚠️ **errata 62b — parent `f080538813` == exactly the base the legs were counted on.** No re-basing on this entry; ⛔ still checked rather than assumed.

| leg | expected | parent | merge | |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `Version Packages` in `.changeset/README.md` | 1 → 0 | 1 | 0 | ✅ |
| `Version Packages` in `CONTRIBUTING.md` | 1 → 0 | 1 | 0 | ✅ |
| `changeset-release` in `.changeset/README.md` | 0 → 3 | 0 | 3 | ✅ |
| `changeset-release` in `CONTRIBUTING.md` | 0 → 3 | 0 | 3 | ✅ |
| ⭐ `Version Packages` in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` | 5 → 5 | 5 | 5 | ✅ |

⭐ The must-STAY leg is the one worth having. The obvious way to over-deliver was to grep the phantom string out of the whole tree — including a file explicitly fenced out, whose five remaining mentions are **correct**: comment prose sitting above a predicate that already reads the head branch, plus a test-case name whose own fixture is `head: { ref: 'changeset-release/main' }`. A one-sided 「0 hits repo-wide」 would have scored that over-reach as success.

### What shipped

`.changeset/README.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` no longer teach a PR **title** this repository's bot has never produced. They now name the Changesets action's own convention — the `changeset-release/<base>` head branch — give the searchable form (`is:pr is:open head:changeset-release`), and **point at the artefact that re-derives the title** rather than restating one:

```
.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml:1254          title: 'chore: release packages'
```

⭐ I read that line before accepting. A document that cites a file is only an improvement if the citation holds; one that teaches a *new* wrong thing is worse than one that teaches an old one.

⭐ And the explanation is what should stop the recurrence rather than just fix the text: it says **why** the head branch is stable (the action derives it from the base branch, so it holds in every repository running the action) and **why** the title is not (it is this repository's own `title:` input — repository-local configuration, which is exactly why `objectui` reads `chore: release packages` while the sibling repo reads `chore: version packages`). The card recorded that divergence as a symptom; the documents now explain its cause.

### ⭐ Three refusals in this round, all correct

1. ⛔ **`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` was NOT touched.** Triage measured — and the round independently re-verified on today's tip — that it already discriminates on `(pr.head?.ref ?? '').startsWith('changeset-release/')`. ⇒ **no committed artefact ever queried the title**; the false clearance the card records was a seat hand-typing a search in a comment. Fixing the script would have been a no-op PR of exactly the kind that burned objectui#8397's first cycle.
2. ⭐ **No ablation, and the slot left honestly empty.** This PR adds no gate and no assertion, so nothing's failure could be demonstrated by mutation. Saying so beats manufacturing a ritual mutation — a fabricated ablation is the 「green about nothing」 shape this lane refuses by name.
3. ⭐ **Two out-of-scope findings NOT filed, each with its reason stated** — the fenced file's surviving mentions, and the sibling repo's charter mentions, which are **prohibitions rather than query instructions** and were already filed by triage as objectstack#17830 and **closed by its own merged PR #17850**. ⇒ checking whether the thing is already fixed *before* filing is the habit that would have saved objectui#8397 a whole cycle.

⚠️ Recorded rather than smoothed over: the report's `mcp_calls` reads 7 in its GitHub copy and 8 in the terminal copy, because the first was written before its own read-back. The dev flagged the discrepancy itself instead of leaving two numbers standing unexplained.

Closing objectui#9134, stripping `pm:*` and the assignee.
